m: Brown the mince hard in a heavy pot. Add the diced onion and capsicum and cook 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and all the spices and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the crushed tomatoes, drained beans and ½ cup water per 2 serves.
Simmer low for 30 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until rich and thick. Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Serve the chilli over rice with sour cream, cheese and coriander.
l: One of the best lunches there is. It freezes well too.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the spice labels.
